preflight_correction.failure: The initial global-kernel reconstruction negated a vector that already stored the finite boundary contribution -S_h, so the check stopped at kernel_inverse_(2,)_1.
preflight_correction.correction: The recovered archimedean coefficient is now the stored finite boundary value itself, equivalently -S_h restricted to the chosen half. This agrees with the manuscript formula h_infinity=-S_h|H_plus.
